title: Memo: Gala Buffet Tonight — Steward Staffing Math

fields.orgName: Halcyon Reach Cruises — MV Halcyon Dawn
fields.department: Hotel Operations: Food and Beverage / Housekeeping
fields.subject: Gala buffet tonight: staffing math
fields.body:
Hotel Director,

The formal-night gala buffet (19:30–22:00, about 2,400 guests expected) can run only as crew-served stations. That needs 64 servers in gloves. F&B has 38 free after the dining rooms, so we are 26 short. The only pool is cabin stewards.

Current steward use:
- 40 on isolation meal routes (61 cabins plus companion trays, running 40 minutes late)
- 46 on the 2-hour public-area cycle
- the rest on cabin turns, with 210 aft cabins already missed last night

If we pull 26 for the gala, one of two things happens from 19:00 to 22:00: either the 2-hour cycle in the guest public areas drops to 4-hourly, or tray delivery slips past an hour. The same steward cannot serve on a station and do a wipe-down round.

Gowns are at 31 percent of stock.

Do we run the gala crew-served or cancel it? We need an answer by 13:00 to brief the galley.
fields.signatureBlock:
Food and Beverage Director
Executive Housekeeper
MV Halcyon Dawn
fields.classification: INTERNAL — CREW ONLY — NOT FOR GUEST DISTRIBUTION

instructorNote: This memo forces a written trade-off on stewards by 13:00. At 2 percent, HOPRPG 5 keeps self-service closed. The gala can run crew-served only if the 2-hourly cleaning and the isolation tray routes stay whole, because stewards cannot serve and clean at the same time (HR-ORG-04 6). Otherwise the gala is cancelled or scaled back, and the Master confirms. Watch for players letting guest disappointment outweigh containment, and see whether anyone flags the gown stock.
